The '''wrist clamp magnetic holstering lock''' was a [[Holster/Legends|holster]] designed for use with the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms']] [[Adjudicator (slugthrower)|Adjudicator]]. It holstered the weapon on the wielder's wrist for quick access.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
